class.name: PCGPointTransform3D
class.brief_description: Deterministic, stable-ID procedural rotation and scale for 3D point transforms.
class.description: A data-only, bounded subset of Unreal PCG Transform Points. Each input point retains its exact position, while its local Y-axis rotation and horizontal/vertical scale are deterministically randomized from a nonnegative stable ID and seed. Random streams do not use global or instance RNG state. The result can be used in instanced scene geometry without creating nodes or meshes.

method.name: generate_transforms
method.description: Returns one Transform3D per source position. The position is unchanged; yaw is selected from [-max_yaw/2, max_yaw/2], horizontal scale affects X and Z equally, and vertical scale affects Y independently. Three salted 32-bit avalanche hashes use the point's stable ID and seed; reordered inputs with the same IDs retain identical yaw and scale. Coordinates must be finite and within +/-10000000, IDs and seed must be within [0, 2147483647], arrays must match and contain at most 16384 points. Max yaw must be finite in [0, 2*pi]; scale range endpoints finite in [0.01, 10] with min <= max. Invalid input yields an empty Array without partial output. Valid empty inputs also yield empty. Does not alter placement, physics, scene objects, global RNG, or GPU resources.
